Pinned commit: b66d02d57e32cc8595369c53418b843e958649b4
Files under include/ and src/ are unmodified upstream sources. LICENSE applies.

Only the client library is linked statically. The signed ViGEmBus driver is
optional and is never installed silently by M&N. The host can open the official
1.22.0 release from the beta dialog. Upstream is retired; no updater or mirror
is used. Mouse/keyboard access and the call do not depend on this driver.
